props.name: children
props.description: `ParallaxPortalLayer`s, placed in the room by their `depth`.

props.name: walls
props.description: What is painted on each surface of the room. Any surface left out gets a lined panel.

props.name: depth
props.description: How deep the room goes behind the frame, px.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Distance from the eye to the frame, px. Smaller exaggerates depth.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How far the eye may travel, as a fraction of half the frame.

props.name: idle
props.description: Drift slowly on its own while nobody is pointing at it.

props.name: tilt
props.description: Offer a button to steer with the phone’s tilt, where the device has one.

props.name: className
props.description: Merged last, so it wins. Give it a height.
